subject: Burnout on Xbox 360
author: Xandu
body:
Hi, I just tried the original Burnout on my Xbox 360 Premium and it works just fine.

What kind of XBox 360 do you have? Do you have the new Xbox 360 S? If so you need to have a official Microsoft Harddrive in it (like this one: XBox 320 GB HD )  It needs to be a MS drive not a cheap copy from China. I don't think flashdrives will work. The reason why it has to be a official drive is that they have a special partition on them that are needed for XBOX games to work.

There is some more information here: http://forum.teamxbox.com/showthread.php?t=653208

Let us know how you get on.
